description: Discover available tools on the Fan Token Intel MCP server. Returns tool names and one-line descriptions, organized by category. Call with no arguments for all categories, or specify a category to filter. Categories: market_data, signals, sports, social, defi, agent, portfolio, volume, chain_info. Tip: connect with ?modules=market_data,signals to load only specific categories.

category.description: Filter to a specific category (optional). Omit for all.

name: tokenintel_discover
